findings.summary: The authoritative comparison-summary validator does not rederive metrics, top-32 vectors, selected tokens, margins, stability booleans, or classification from the bound payloads.
findings.smallest_repair: Rederive the complete comparison from bound payloads inside validation and require exact summary equality.

findings.summary: Comparison routing manifests need not be the manifests whose SHAs are bound by the corresponding receipts and package closure.
findings.smallest_repair: Require comparison and closure routing SHAs to equal the routing SHAs in both validated receipts.

findings.summary: Receipt role and package/event authority labels are not fully checked against the bound manifest, summary, and routing identities.
findings.smallest_repair: Constrain role and require exact package-attempt and consumer-event identities throughout receipt construction and validation.

findings.summary: A top-32 summary can carry a caller-supplied consumer event unrelated to its logits payload and has no package-attempt binding.
findings.smallest_repair: Derive and validate both package-attempt and consumer-event identities from the logits payload.

findings.summary: A manifest does not require three distinct payload leaves, so equal-geometry hidden and normalized nodes can alias one banked file.
